verdict.rationale: Runloop's own docs explicitly describe browser automation as running externally (via Browserbase or Kernel) with Playwright connecting over CDP, stating 'no Chromium ever runs in the devbox' — the opposite of running a headless browser inside the sandbox. There is no mention anywhere in the docs of a full desktop/GUI environment running inside a Devbox either. Since all evidence comes from a single tier (claimed-docs/probe), this cannot be marked 'disputed', but the applicable capability is not delivered as described in the story.
